checks.name: Day creation and reload
checks.result: Created a day without stops; private title and Odia note survived reload alongside an eight-idea starter.

checks.name: Whole-day movement
checks.result: Konark moved from day 2 to day 3, retaining its item note. The quiet day stayed on day 1.

checks.name: Shift and undo
checks.result: A +1 shift moved the quiet day to 2 and Konark to 4. Undo restored day 1 and day 3 with their notes.

checks.name: Guarded undo
checks.result: After a further shift and a newer Konark note, Undo refused to discard the intervening edit.

checks.name: Private-copy choice
checks.result: Unchecking personal notes removed PRIVATE day-title/day-note/item-note strings from print DOM. Saved textarea values remained. Notebook prompts stayed in print.

checks.name: Copy between journeys
checks.result: Konark remained in the source; the destination received the same item note under Ideas for later, without the source day metadata.

checks.name: Stale-tab protection
checks.result: A title edit in a second tab disabled Add day, Shift and day-title fields in the older tab. Book export remained available.

checks.name: Notes-only journey
checks.result: Created a separate zero-idea journey with a named day and note. Reload retained it; text/book controls enabled and print included the note. Invoked text download; downloaded file bytes were not inspected.

checks.name: Private day search
checks.result: Searching sketch exposed only the note-only day group, with no search string added to the URL.

limits: File import compatibility and export byte content verified by automated tests; browser file-picker import was not exercised.
Empty-day removal uses confirmation but the native confirm interaction was not exercised here.
Actual PDF output remains unverified; no publication or external submission.
